import z3
from itertools import combinations

n = 21
vertices = list(range(n))
edges = list(combinations(vertices, 2))
edge_vars = {e: z3.Bool(f'e_{e[0]}_{e[1]}') for e in edges}

# Degree constraints
s = z3.Solver()
for v in vertices:
    incident = [edge_vars[tuple(sorted((v, u)))] for u in vertices if u != v]
    deg = z3.Sum([z3.If(e, 1, 0) for e in incident])
    s.add(deg >= 4)
    s.add(deg <= 6)

# No triangles: for every triple, not all three edges
for triple in combinations(vertices, 3):
    e1 = edge_vars[tuple(sorted((triple[0], triple[1])))]
    e2 = edge_vars[tuple(sorted((triple[0], triple[2])))]
    e3 = edge_vars[tuple(sorted((triple[1], triple[2])))]
    s.add(z3.Not(z3.And(e1, e2, e3)))

# No C4: for every quadruple, forbid each of the three possible 4-cycles
for quad in combinations(vertices, 4):
    a, b, c, d = sorted(quad)
    # Three possible cycles: (a-b-c-d-a), (a-b-d-c-a), (a-c-b-d-a)
    # Cycle1: a-b, b-c, c-d, d-a
    c1 = [tuple(sorted((a,b))), tuple(sorted((b,c))), tuple(sorted((c,d))), tuple(sorted((d,a)))]
    # Cycle2: a-b, b-d, d-c, c-a
    c2 = [tuple(sorted((a,b))), tuple(sorted((b,d))), tuple(sorted((d,c))), tuple(sorted((c,a)))]
    # Cycle3: a-c, c-b, b-d, d-a
    c3 = [tuple(sorted((a,c))), tuple(sorted((c,b))), tuple(sorted((b,d))), tuple(sorted((d,a)))]
    s.add(z3.Not(z3.And([edge_vars[e] for e in c1])))
    s.add(z3.Not(z3.And([edge_vars[e] for e in c2])))
    s.add(z3.Not(z3.And([edge_vars[e] for e in c3])))

print(s.check())

model = s.model()
selected_edges = [e for e, var in edge_vars.items() if model.evaluate(var)]
print(selected_edges)
print(len(selected_edges))
